title: Market Ask Below Purchase Cost
dataSources: Chrono24 listings (`chrono24:listing`), WatchBox service records (`watchbox:service`), wrist-time logs (`watch:wristtime`), and watch service history (`watch:service`).
app: Chrono24 listing snapshots, WatchBox service records, wrist-time wear logs, and in-house service history exports ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=chrono24:listing reference_number=* ask_price_usd=*
| join type=inner reference_number [search index=personal sourcetype=watch:wristtime | stats latest(purchase_price_usd) as cost by reference_number]
| eval loss_usd=round(cost-ask_price_usd,2)
| where loss_usd>0
| sort - loss_usd
| table reference_number brand cost ask_price_usd loss_usd
description: Finds watches whose current Chrono24 ask is below recorded purchase cost.
value: Underwater references help decide whether to hold, sell, or rotate pieces before the market moves further.
implementation: Maintain `purchase_price_usd` per reference and compare nightly against Chrono24 `ask_price_usd`.
visualization: Table of references with market loss amount.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks watches worth less on the market right now than you paid for them.
